Yeah guys, this is my first proper map, named graecus
imgur:http://imgur.com/a/Y7lNA
download:https://www.dropbox.com/sh/kydp7yzo74iatsk/AACLqqtcwMSrn63mwnRKpvmXa?dl=0

Would like to have Feedback :)
The map contains:
even amount of diamonds on each sides
pots at mid can give an extra bonus for a team though
plains for both strafing and sniping
extra rushing ways around the sides
small map means not all too crowded

Special thx to MonsieurGray for helping me with the YML and itaity for helping me with the download.

replies.author: Pavlo
replies.body:
Looking really good!

As stated before, it does look a bit plain in places. I realize this is what Greek buildings would have looked like, so maybe just add a few small extra things in places? Or you could add some more Greek columns, as that would keep the style the same, but would look better :D And one other thing, perhaps make a paths a little bit wider.
Everything else looks great! Love the layout, not too cramped, but not too spread out either! Looks like a fun map :)
Hope this helps!

replies.author: Doppelganger_
replies.body:
Some feedback:

  • I'm not one to speak about aesthetics but it just seems too white for me. Maybe mix up the block palette
  • Also the buildings look quite plain. Add more detail

  • Also I feel you have a bit too many blocks in the spawn kit for the size of the map you have made
  • I really think you could have more than 15v15 maybe 20v20 I'm not sure we have to see after this map gets accepted
  • I'm not sure if you meant to do this but in the Yaml you have one team named "Athena" and the other "Sparta". I'm not sure if you wanted Team Athena to be named Athens (which is the city) rather than Athena (who is the god).
  • The front lines seem too small
  • Also could you tell me where the monuments are. I really don't know.
